labloop_rationale: No data yet, so slots test the goal-relevant literature hypotheses (H5, H7, H8, H9, H6); H4 parked because their regions cannot meet the spec.
planner_rationale: Round 1, no data yet. Seed with broad coverage of the Sn-Pb bowing region (H7, H8) so we can learn both bandgap and T80 for low-to-moderate Sn Cs/FA iodides. The critic noted Sn is untested and H3 (Sn>=0.3 oxidation) may be a cliff. Prefer cheap Pb-rich/low-Sn films first (1.0-1.5 units) to preserve budget.
